title: ApolloLander research-mode development baseline

baselines.name: constant_coast
baselines.note: Zero thrust, nose left; expected crash/timeout floor.

baselines.name: constant_hover_upright
baselines.note: Near-hover thrust, upright; weak scripted control.

baselines.name: hand_specified_guidance
baselines.note: Tuned on the fixed demonstration start; not an LLM.

fixed_start_control.name: hand_specified_guidance_fixed_start
fixed_start_control.note: Control: same guidance on the original fixed spawn.

assessment.rationale: Hand-specified guidance verified landing rate on development research starts is 1.000 (mean reward 83.29; 16 designated perfect touchdowns). Weak scripted baselines do not land. A first LLM pilot on apollolander.starts.v1 is credible; no easier tier is required from this evidence.
assessment.pilot_note: Use the same eight development seeds as research_development_numerical.yaml for a matched first LLM pilot; keep held-out seeds sealed.

note: All controllers are scripted baselines. None are evidence of in-context learning.
